Package com.bilt.pos.session.settlement

Class OriginalSaleRecord

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.session.settlement.OriginalSaleRecord
public final class OriginalSaleRecord extends Object
References from a completed sale that a later checkout session can use to void the whole original transaction or allocate return settlement.

    • sharesMovementWith

      public boolean sharesMovementWith(OriginalSaleRecord other)
      Whether this record and other reference any of the same POI transactions. Movement type is deliberately ignored: a transaction ID reused in different legs still identifies an overlapping sale target.
      Parameters:
      other - record to compare with this one
      Returns:
      whether the records share at least one POI transaction ID
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if other is null
